subject.title: feat: add safe hybrid local archive collection

question: Should Discrawl support this hybrid local/archive workflow, including persisted exclusions that affect live ingestion and routine Git snapshot merges, as a long-term core contract?
rationale: The patch adds durable configuration and behavior across multiple ingestion paths; code review cannot determine whether the project intends to own these upgrade and support guarantees.

options.title: Adopt the core workflow
options.body: Accept hybrid collection as supported core behavior and require its preservation, exclusion, and force-update semantics to remain documented and tested.

options.title: Narrow or defer the feature
options.body: Keep the current archive workflow unchanged and split any independently desired safeguards or scheduler improvements into narrower follow-up work.

recommendation.title: Adopt the core workflow
recommendation.body: Accept hybrid collection as supported core behavior and require its preservation, exclusion, and force-update semantics to remain documented and tested.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository member who authored the design and its follow-up safeguards is the clearest available routing point for the intended feature contract.
